common.dirtyBlocked: Save or discard your changes before using these actions.
common.loadErrorBody: The list is temporarily unavailable. Reload the page or try again shortly.

fieldErrors.too_small: This value is missing, too short or too small.
fieldErrors.too_big: This value is too large or there are too many items.
fieldErrors.invalid_type: This value has the wrong type.
fieldErrors.invalid_format: Enter a valid address starting with https://.
fieldErrors.invalid_value: Choose one of the offered options.
fieldErrors.invalid_union: This value has an invalid format.
fieldErrors.control_characters: Remove line breaks and control characters.
fieldErrors.credentials_not_allowed: Addresses with a user name or password are not allowed.
fieldErrors.invalid_local_time: Enter a valid date and time.
fieldErrors.nonexistent_local_time: This time does not exist in the chosen time zone (clocks jump forward). Choose another time.
fieldErrors.out_of_range: The date must be between the years 2000 and 2099.
fieldErrors.not_started: The match has not started yet. Results and the live status are possible from one hour before the start.
fieldErrors.invalid_slug: Use lower-case letters without diacritics, digits and hyphens only.
fieldErrors.slug_taken: This address is already used by another record.
fieldErrors.invalid_short_code: Use letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores (max. 12).
fieldErrors.duplicate_ordinal: Two rounds have the same order.
fieldErrors.outcome_inconsistent: The outcome does not match the scores.
fieldErrors.scores_both_or_neither: Enter both scores, or leave both empty when the score is unknown.
fieldErrors.verified_requires_result: A verified result needs known scores or an explicit outcome.
fieldErrors.scores_require_completed: Round scores can only be saved for a completed match. Use “Record result”.
fieldErrors.cancelled: A cancelled match has no result.
fieldErrors.asset_unavailable: This image is not available (deleted, still processing or outside the allowed media scope).
fieldErrors.alt_required: Describe the image, or mark it as decorative.
fieldErrors.consent_required: Publication is refused: the member's consent has not been recorded yet.
fieldErrors.discord_invite_required: Enter a Discord invitation (https://discord.gg/… or https://discord.com/invite/…).
fieldErrors.origin_not_allowed: This address is not allowed. Use a same-site path (/…) or an allowlisted https origin.
fieldErrors.provenance_required: Provenance is required when background media is set.
fieldErrors.duplicate_url: Each link must have a different address.
fieldErrors.duplicates: Each item can be selected only once.
fieldErrors.unknown_setting: This setting cannot be changed here.
fieldErrors.conflict: Someone else changed this setting in the meantime.
fieldErrors.invalid_content: The text contains content that cannot be saved. Remove unusual formatting and try again.
fieldErrors.hll_side: Choose Allies or Axis (or leave it empty).
fieldErrors.hll_sector_score: In HLL a round score is the number of sectors held: 0 to 5.
fieldErrors.invalid_scoreboard: Neither the file nor the server response contains a game scoreboard with player statistics.
fieldErrors.unknown_server: This server is not configured as a statistics source.
fieldErrors.hll_only: Game statistics can be imported for Hell Let Loose matches only.

media.selectedUnknown: An image from the media library is selected.

prose.savedNotice: {lang, select, cs {Czech draft saved.} other {English draft saved.}} It is not public until you publish it.
prose.publishedNotice: {lang, select, cs {Czech version published.} other {English version published.}} The other language was not changed.
prose.unpublishedNotice: {lang, select, cs {Czech version removed} other {English version removed}} from the public website. The draft is kept.
prose.absenceTitle: {lang, select, cs {No published Czech version} other {No published English version}}
prose.absent: Visitors of the {lang, select, cs {Czech website} other {English website}} see an honest “not available in this language” notice. Nothing is translated or filled in automatically.
prose.absentWithOther: Visitors of the {lang, select, cs {Czech website} other {English website}} see a “not available in this language” notice with a link to the published {lang, select, cs {English version} other {Czech version}}. Nothing is translated automatically.
prose.editingRecap: Recap · {lang, select, cs {Czech content} other {English content}} ({code})
prose.editingBiography: Biography · {lang, select, cs {Czech content} other {English content}} ({code})
prose.canvasRecap: Recap text ({lang, select, cs {Czech content} other {English content}})
prose.canvasBiography: Biography text ({lang, select, cs {Czech content} other {English content}})
prose.notLive: {lang, select, cs {The Czech version is not published} other {The English version is not published}}
prose.coverAlt: Cover alternative text ({lang, select, cs {Czech version} other {English version}})
prose.coverAltHint: Describe the cover image for people who cannot see it.
prose.coverCaption: Cover caption ({lang, select, cs {Czech version} other {English version}})
prose.coverDecorative: The cover image is decorative (no alternative text)
prose.saveDraft: {lang, select, cs {Save Czech draft} other {Save English draft}}
prose.publish: {lang, select, cs {Publish Czech version} other {Publish English version}}
prose.publishChanges: {lang, select, cs {Publish Czech changes} other {Publish English changes}}
prose.unpublish: {lang, select, cs {Unpublish Czech version} other {Unpublish English version}}
prose.saveBeforePublish: Save the draft first; only saved drafts can be published.
prose.noPublishPermission: You can save drafts; publishing requires publication rights.

rounds.intro: Optional maps or rounds in playing order; every round field is optional. Plan them before the match (Save changes) and add their scores together with the result.
rounds.count: {count, plural, =0 {No rounds} one {# round} other {# rounds}}
rounds.hllIntro: Hell Let Loose: one round is one map. The score is sectors held (0–5); the side is Allies or Axis.

list.title: Matches
list.description: Fixtures and results. The match status (scheduled, postponed, completed…) is independent of publication on the website. Times are shown in Europe/Prague.
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}

filters.rangeInverted: The end date is before the start date.
filters.label: Match filters

list.filteredEmptyBody: Change or clear the filters to see more matches.
list.emptyBody: Create the first fixture. It stays a private draft until you publish it.
list.caption: Matches

editor.createIntro: A new match is saved as a private draft with the status Scheduled. Publishing it is a separate, explicit step.
editor.conflictBody: This match was changed in the meantime, so nothing was saved. Your entered values are kept. Load the latest version to continue with your values on top of it, or discard your changes.
editor.reloadedNotice: The latest saved version was loaded. Your unsaved values are still in the form; review them and save again.
editor.createdNotice: Draft match created. It is not public yet.
editor.resultSavedNotice: Result saved. The match is now completed.
editor.postponedNotice: Match postponed. The original start is kept and shown publicly.
editor.publishedNotice: Match published. It now appears on the public website.
editor.unpublishedNotice: Match unpublished. It no longer appears on the public website.
editor.noResult: No result recorded — public pages show “—”, never 0:0.

hints.opponentShortCode: E.g. a clan tag. Letters, digits, dots and hyphens.
hints.opponentLogo: Approved image from the match media library.
hints.format: E.g. “5v5 attack/defence”. Only when it applies to the game.
hints.teamSize: Players per team, only when it applies.
hints.timeZone: The time is entered as wall-clock time in this zone and stored as an exact instant.
hints.slug: Leave empty to generate it from the date and opponent.
hints.cover: Shared cover for both languages; alternative text and caption are written per language in the recap.
hints.outcomeUnknown: Without scores, choose the outcome explicitly (or leave it unknown).
hints.provisional: Not yet confirmed; shown as provisional.
hints.source: Where the result comes from, e.g. the league website.
hints.internalNotes: Never shown on the public website, in recaps or in previews.

editor.scheduleIntro: When the match is played. This is not the time the match page is published.
editor.resolvedMissing: Enter a date and time to see the exact start.
editor.startNotPublication: The start time does not publish anything: the page becomes public only through “Publish”.
editor.rescheduleReady: The new start is not saved yet.
editor.rescheduleHint: Edit the date, time or zone above, then change the start time.
editor.rescheduleUnavailable: The start can be changed only for scheduled or postponed matches.
editor.vodIntro: Up to {max} approved https links, shown as ordinary links.
editor.recapPrivateUntilPublished: The match itself is not published, so no recap is public in any language yet.
editor.recapAfterCreate: Save the draft first; Czech and English recaps can then be written and published independently.
editor.resultIntro: Unknown scores stay empty and are shown as “—”, never as 0:0. Recording a result marks the match as completed.
editor.resultCancelled: A cancelled match has no result.
editor.resultTooEarly: This match starts later; results can be recorded from one hour before the start.
editor.resultHint: Saves the scores, outcome, verification, source and rounds together.
editor.statusExplainer: Match status describes the game; publication decides whether the website shows it.
editor.noPublishPermission: You can edit this match; publishing requires the match publication right.
editor.createAside: After saving you can publish, postpone, cancel or record the result here.

dialogs.postponeBody: The original start ({date}) is kept and shown publicly. Enter a new start now, or leave it empty until it is agreed.
dialogs.postponeZone: The new time is in the {zone} time zone.
dialogs.cancelBody: The match stays in the history as cancelled and cannot receive a result.
dialogs.unpublishBody: The match disappears from all public lists and its page, including recaps in both languages.
dialogs.deleteBody: The draft match against {opponent} will be deleted permanently, including its recaps and rounds.

list.title: Member profiles
list.description: Public member profiles. A profile becomes public only with recorded consent and explicit publication.
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No profiles} one {# profile} other {# profiles}}
list.emptyBody: Create the first public member profile.
list.caption: Member profiles

editor.createIntro: A new profile is a private draft. It becomes public only after the member's consent is recorded and the profile is published.
editor.createdNotice: Draft profile created. It is not public.
editor.conflictBody: This profile was changed in the meantime, so nothing was saved. Your entered values are kept.
editor.reloadedNotice: The latest saved version was loaded. Your unsaved values are still in the form.

hints.displayName: Shown exactly as entered, including diacritics and emoji. Only surrounding spaces are removed.
hints.slugCreate: Leave empty to generate it from the display name.
hints.slugEdit: Changing the address of a published profile breaks existing links.
hints.avatar: Approved image from the editorial media library.
hints.roles: Curated public labels only. They never grant permissions and are not Discord roles.

editor.bioPrivateUntilPublic: The profile is not public, so no biography is public in any language yet.
editor.bioAfterCreate: Save the profile first; Czech and English biographies can then be written independently.
editor.consentCheckbox: I confirm that {name} has agreed to publish this profile (name, avatar, games, roles and biography).
editor.consentSavedNotice: Consent recorded (audited). The profile can now be published.
editor.publishedNotice: Profile published. It is now visible on the public website.
editor.hiddenNotice: Profile hidden. It is no longer public.
editor.withdrawnNotice: Consent withdrawn. The profile is not public.
editor.publishNeedsConsent: Publishing is refused until the member's consent is recorded.
editor.noPublishPermission: You can edit drafts; publishing requires publication rights.
editor.createAside: After saving, record the member's consent and publish the profile here.
editor.previewLive: These values are public now (after saving).
editor.previewPrivate: Nothing is public yet. After consent and publication visitors will see:
editor.previewNeverPublic: Never public: the linked Discord account and its identifiers, e-mail, guild roles, consent records and internal state.

dialogs.hideBody: The profile and its biographies disappear from the public website. You can publish it again later.
dialogs.withdrawBody: The withdrawal is recorded in the audit log. A published profile is hidden immediately and cannot be published again until new consent is recorded.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.description: Public community links and background media. Only administrators and owners can change them; saving makes them live immediately.
settings.conflictBody: Another administrator saved settings in the meantime, so nothing was saved. Your entered values are kept.
settings.reloadLatest: Load latest saved settings (keep my values)
settings.reloadedNotice: The latest saved settings were loaded as the base. Review your values and save again.
settings.savedBody: The changes are live on the public website now.
settings.liveChanged: Live now (your change is not saved)
settings.neverSaved: No override saved; the server default applies.
settings.storedInvalid: The stored value no longer passes validation (for example, its origin was removed from the allowlist) and is ignored; the default applies.
settings.communityIntro: Links shown in the header, footer and community page. Only https addresses are accepted.

hints.discordDefault: Leave empty to use the server default ({url}).
hints.discordNoDefault: Leave empty to show no invitation.
hints.mediaUrl: Same-site path (/…) or an allowlisted https origin. The server never downloads it.
hints.focal: 0–100; the part of the image kept visible when it is cropped.
hints.provenance: Required when any media is set: who made it and under which approval.

settings.linksIntro: Up to {max} links, in the order shown.
settings.backgroundIntro: Poster and looping video of the main-menu scene. Visitors can pause it; reduced motion and data saving show the poster only.
settings.modeDefaultHint: Use the media configured by the operator.
settings.modeCustomHint: Use the values below. Leaving every URL empty shows the original fallback scene.
settings.originsNone: No external origins are allowlisted; only same-site paths are accepted.

preview.title: Preview of the proposed background
preview.explainer: Not the live site: this frame shows your unsaved values with the same crop, fallback and pause behaviour.
preview.invalid: No preview: fix the highlighted fields first.
preview.failedPoster: Preview failed: the poster could not be loaded from this address. Visitors would see the fallback scene.
preview.failedVideo: Preview failed: the video could not be played from these addresses. Visitors would see the poster or fallback scene.
preview.failedBoth: Preview failed: neither the poster nor the video could be loaded. Visitors would see the fallback scene.
preview.fallbackOnly: No media: visitors see the original fallback scene.
preview.readyWithVideo: Poster ready. Press Play to test the video.
preview.reducedMotion: Your system prefers reduced motion: nothing plays automatically. The public site shows only the poster in this case.
preview.noAutoplay: The preview never plays automatically in the administration.

settings.dirtyStatus: {count, plural, one {# setting changed — not saved} other {# settings changed — not saved}}
settings.saveGoesLive: Saving makes these settings live on the public website immediately. There is no separate publish step.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Read-only, redacted history of privileged changes and denied actions. Records cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.rangeHint: Dates are inclusive days in Europe/Prague; at most {days} days. Without dates the last 30 days are shown.

filterErrors.range_too_long: The date range can be at most {days} days.
filterErrors.range_inverted: The end date is before the start date.

audit.count: {count, plural, =0 {No events} one {# event} other {# events}}
audit.emptyBody: Nothing privileged was recorded in the last 30 days.
audit.caption: Audit events
audit.summaryTruncated: The summary is longer; only the first lines are shown.
audit.redactionNote: Secrets, tokens, session identifiers and e-mail addresses are never shown.
audit.detailMissingBody: The selected event does not exist.

statistics.intro: Statistics of the played game from the game server (CRCON) add team totals, weapons and optionally players to the public match detail. They are stored separately from the match result, with their source and import time.
statistics.teamsCaption: Team totals in the imported game
statistics.sideHint: Assigns the teams in the statistics to Valkyria and the opponent.
statistics.publishPlayersHint: In-game names and numbers of both teams. Unchecked, only team and weapon totals are public.
statistics.replaceTitle: Replace statistics with a new import
statistics.sourceOptionCrconHint: The website downloads the game scoreboard from the configured server.
statistics.noSources: No CRCON server is configured yet (HLL_SERVER_SOURCES_JSON).
statistics.sourceOptionUploadHint: A CRCON game scoreboard export (get_map_scoreboard response).
statistics.gameIdHint: The game number from CRCON public statistics (e.g. …/games/1234).
statistics.fileHint: JSON file; per-kill details are left out before sending.
statistics.importNote: An import replaces the statistics previously stored for this match.
